abilities.name: Scarab Host
abilities.text: Using an Ability spawns a Beetle which loses Health over 10 seconds, attacking nearby enemies for 20 damage.

abilities.name: Impale
abilities.text: Deals 90 damage. Stuns for 1 second.

abilities.name: Harden Carapace
abilities.text: Gain a Shield that grants 40 Spell Armor and absorbs 340 damage over 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Burrow Charge
abilities.text:
Burrow to the target location, dealing 91 damage and briefly stunning enemies in a small area upon surfacing, slowing them by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

Burrow Charge can be reactivated to surface early.

abilities.name: Locust Swarm
abilities.text: Deal 68 damage per second to nearby enemies. Each enemy damaged restores 24 Health. Lasts 6 seconds.

abilities.name: Cocoon
abilities.text: Wraps target enemy Hero in a cocoon, rendering them unable to act or be targeted for 7 seconds. Allies of the Hero can attack the cocoon to break it and free them early.

1.name: Nerubian Armor
1.text: Increase Harden Carapace's Spell Armor by 25.

1.name: Legion of Beetles
1.text: Beetles have 30 Spell Armor. Automatically spawn a Beetle every 12 seconds. Can be toggled on and off.

1.name: Regeneration Master
1.text:
Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases your Health Regeneration by 1 per second, up to 30.

Reward: After gathering 25 Regeneration Globes, you also gain 500 Health.

4.name: Bed of Barbs
4.text: Create a bed of spikes along Impale's path that Slows enemies by 25% and deals 21 damage per second. Spikes persist for 3.5 seconds.

4.name: Shed Exoskeleton
4.text: Harden Carapace grants 30% increased Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

4.name: Underking
4.text: Increases Burrow Charge range by 20% and damage by 100%.

7.name: Chitinous Plating
7.text: While Harden Carapace is active, taking damage from enemy Abilities reduces its cooldown by 1 second, up to 3 seconds.

7.name: Subterranean Shield
7.text: Burrow Charge also grants a 400 point Shield for 5 seconds.

7.name: Leeching Scarabs
7.text: Beetles attacks deal 30% more damage and heal Anub'arak 50% of damage dealt if he is nearby.

10.name: Locust Swarm
10.text: Deal 68 damage per second to nearby enemies. Each enemy damaged restores 24 Health. Lasts 6 seconds.

10.name: Cocoon
10.text: Wraps target enemy Hero in a cocoon, rendering them unable to act or be targeted for 7 seconds. Allies of the Hero can attack the cocoon to break it and free them early.

13.name: Urticating Spines
13.text: Casting Harden Carapace will also deal 90 damage to nearby enemies. Deals double damage against Heroes.

13.name: Burning Beetles
13.text: Deal 21 damage per second to nearby enemies. Beetles deal 6 damage per second to nearby enemies.

13.name: Acid-Drenched Mandibles
13.text: Attacking a Hero that is Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned increases Anub'arak's Basic Attack damage by 80% for 4 seconds.

16.name: Epicenter
16.text: Increases Burrow Charge impact area by 60% and lowers the cooldown by 1 second for each Hero hit.

16.name: Debilitation
16.text: Enemy Heroes hit by Burrow Charge or Impale have their Spell Power reduced by 50% for 4 seconds.

16.name: Beetle, Juiced
16.text:
Passive: Beetles gain 30% increased health.

Every 4th Basic Attack spawns a Beetle.

20.name: Hive Master
20.text: Gain a permanent Vampire Locust that attacks a nearby enemy every 3 seconds. The Vampire Locust deals 165 damage and returns to heal Anub'arak for 80 health.

20.name: Cryptweave
20.text: Staying near the Cocoon allows Anub'arak to extend the duration by up to 6 seconds per Cocoon. Upon exiting the Cocoon, enemies take 60 damage over 4 seconds. This damage is increased by 100% for each second that they were inside.

20.name: The Traitor King
20.text:
Gain 10% bonus maximum Health and 20 Spell Armor.

Activate to gain 75 Armor for 4 seconds.

20.name: Rewind
20.text: Activate to reset the cooldowns of your Basic Abilities.
